items.name: retail-format
items.title: Retail format
items.description: Money, units, percent, price index and weeks of cover, formatted the way a category manager reads them (en-AU by default).

items.name: one-open
items.title: One open
items.description: Keeps one hover card open at a time, so sweeping across a row of badges never stacks two cards.

items.name: market-side
items.title: Market side
items.description: The favourable / exposed / level tone every catman figure shares, the arrow that carries it without colour, and the two colour tokens behind it.

items.name: price-position
items.title: Price position
items.description: Where our prices sit against a competitor (12% above, 4% below, in line), as a chip or as a badge with the index and matched-line evidence on hover.

items.name: price-trend
items.title: Price trend
items.description: Weekly price position against the market as a small line with a dashed parity line; hover or arrow through any week for its index and change.

items.name: price-scoreboard
items.title: Price scoreboard
items.description: The four numbers atop a pricing page: overall position vs market with its index and trend, then lines priced above, in line and below, each optionally a filter.

items.name: micro-trend
items.title: Micro trend
items.description: A small inline chart of one or more lines over time for a table cell or tile: sales vs forecast with a dashed forecast, P10–P90 band and a this-week marker; gaps left blank; a gliding crosshair with a tooltip reading every series.

items.name: micro-stat
items.title: Micro stat
items.description: The figures under a chart: a change indicator ("vs LY ▲6.2%") toned by whether up is good or bad, and a labelled figure ("OTB $42k"), each explained in a tooltip.

items.name: weeks-of-cover
items.title: Weeks of cover
items.description: Weeks of stock on hand at the current rate of sale, on a track against the healthy band: short (stockout risk), in band, or over (aged cash).
